facts.claim: it has always been sold as a racemate
facts.problem: Doubtful wording, not a factual error (confidence that it needs a change: low). A single-enantiomer S-ibuprofen product (dexibuprofen) has been marketed in some countries since the 1990s, which P8 S6 itself concedes. Read as 'the standard ibuprofen product has always been racemic' the sentence is fine, but 'always' sits in mild tension with S6. Optional tightening: 'it has always been sold mainly as a racemate'.
